title: Match tuning
description: Gameplay tuning owned by the Match domain (Match Flow Bible, Battleground Bible). VeyraMatch binds it to FVeyraMatchTuning.

schemaVersion.description: Version of this file's format. A build reads exactly one version.

teams.description: The two sides of a match.

maxTeamSize.description: Most participants on one side; a match is 5v5 (Battleground Bible, overview).

phases.description: The in-match stages before play (Match Flow Bible §1).

loadingTimeoutSeconds.description: How long loading waits for every required participant before the match proceeds without them (Match Flow Bible §1, stage 2; prototype 90 s).

preparationSeconds.description: Length of fountain preparation before the match clock starts (Match Flow Bible §1, stage 3).

respawn.description: When a dead Vanguard returns at its fountain (Combat Bible §18).

delaySeconds.description: Seconds from a death to the respawn. A placeholder: canon's respawn curve, which grows with level and match time (Economy Bible §14), is not yet ruled (Battleground Bible §16).

orders.description: How the server accepts a player's move orders (ADR-006 §7: server-only movement). Provisional values.

maxPerSecond.description: Sustained orders a player may send per second; the server refuses the rest.

destinationProjectionExtent.description: How far, in units along each axis, a clicked destination may lie from walkable ground and still be accepted.

arrivalTolerance.description: How close, in units, a Vanguard must come to its destination to have arrived.

developerLoadout.description: Scaffolding until Vanguard definitions arrive (M4): the base stats every Vanguard gets in developer matches. Provisional values; Combat Bible §58 leaves per-Vanguard stats open.

maxResource.description: Base Max Resource of the standard resource, Mana (Combat Bible §27, §58). 0 would mean no resource.

moveSpeed.description: Base Move Speed in units per second (Combat Bible §23).

turnRateDegreesPerSecond.description: How fast a Vanguard turns to face where it moves.

capsuleRadius.description: Gameplay collision radius in units; ranges are measured edge to edge from it (Combat Bible §40).

capsuleHalfHeight.description: Half the gameplay collision height in units. Must be at least capsuleRadius.

abilityQ.description: The ability in the Q slot: a content ID that Abilities.json defines.
